subject: Request: confirm elevated latency window and SLO credit (Brightbox Commerce)
messages:
From: Ana Patel <ana@brightbox.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-12T14:09:00Z
Subject: Elevated errors/latency overnight — timeline and credit request

Hi Laura,

We observed a sustained period of elevated tail latency and intermittent 503s affecting our token-generation endpoints yesterday night (metrics point to ~02:15–02:47 UTC on 2027-09-11). Impact: several checkout flows experienced timeouts, resulting in failed card authorizations for roughly 6% of requests during that window.

Can Redwood confirm the exact outage/delay window, whether this qualifies under the Dedicated SLA (99.95% availability), and next steps for SLO credits and a postmortem? Our account team asked me to loop you in.

Attached: a short CSV with sample request IDs and timestamps. We can provide additional traces if needed.

Thanks,
Ana Patel
Head of Site Reliability
Brightbox Commerce

Attachment: brightbox_sample_rows.csv (CSV, 12 rows)

1) Confirm the effective impacted time window from our side (accounting for routing fallbacks).
2) Produce a raw trace/log bundle and an initial RCA hypothesis (we don't need the full postmortem yet, just root cause direction).
3) Estimate whether this will meet Dedicated SLA credit criteria and a ballpark credit amount.

This is a high-value Dedicated account (BB-2027-44) — please prioritize. Thanks.

Laura

---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-12T22:46:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Elevated errors/latency overnight — please validate window and provide traces

Laura — initial findings below after correlating infra traces and controller logs. Attaching the raw trace bundle and a quick credit estimate.

Summary:
- Confirmed elevated P95/P99 latency and ~1.8% 503 spike between 2027-09-11T02:17:00Z and 2027-09-11T02:45:30Z (UTC).
- Root cause (initial): a hot-loop in the autoscaler decision path caused a brief oscillation in worker allocation on one Dedicated GPU pool, which increased queueing and KV-cache churn for the affected model rack.
- Impact: increased tail latency; some requests retried and got 503s before fallback.

Attachments: rbx_raw_trace_20270911_0215-0247.zip (raw traces), slo-credit-estimate.csv (preliminary calc).

Next steps:
- We'll run a targeted replay against the trace to verify the hit on KV cache and confirm exact request counts for credit calc (ETA 6–10 hours).
- Engineering will file a postmortem draft and remediation checklist; I'll include a mitigation to prevent autoscaler hot-loops (patch in staging).

I'll update this thread with the confirmed window and final credit number.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: rbx_raw_trace_20270911_0215-0247.zip (log bundle, 24 MB)
Attachment: slo-credit-estimate.csv (CSV, preliminary)
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Ana Patel <ana@brightbox.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-13T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Elevated errors/latency overnight — timeline and SLO credit estimate

Hi Ana — thanks for your patience. We confirmed the impacted window on our side and the preliminary SLO credit estimate.

Confirmed window (UTC): 2027-09-11 02:17:00 — 2027-09-11 02:45:30
Impact summary:
- Brief autoscaler oscillation in one Dedicated GPU pool increased queue times and KV-cache misses.
- Observed ~1.8% 503 rate for affected routes and a measurable rise in tail latency (P99).

SLO credit (preliminary): per the Dedicated SLA, the impacted availability delta maps to an estimated 18% pro-rata credit of September monthly committed usage for the affected pool. The attached CSV contains the calculation steps; final credit will be issued after the postmortem is finalized.

Next steps:
- We will provide a formal postmortem (root cause, timeline, and remediation) within 5 business days.
- Patch to autoscaler will be staged and rolled with monitoring enhanced to detect hot-looping.
- If you need expedited credits before the PM is published, tell me and I'll route for priority approval.

Apologies for the disruption — we're treating this as a Sev2 for the Dedicated fleet and will share the postmortem when complete.

Best regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Account Manager, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
